## What it is
Network models study how behavior depends on peers and connections:
learning, diffusion, and strategic complementarities.

---

## Canonical linear-quadratic network game
Agent $i$ chooses $x_i\ge 0$ and:
$$
u_i(x)= a_i x_i - \frac{1}{2}x_i^2 + \beta x_i \sum_j g_{ij}x_j.
$$

Best response:
$$
x_i = a_i + \beta \sum_j g_{ij}x_j.
$$

Vector form:
$$
x = (I-\beta G)^{-1}a
$$
when invertible.

---

## Predictions (qualitative)
- shocks to incentives propagate through a network multiplier
- targeting central nodes has outsized effects
- strong complements generate clustering and persistence
